# forge Command Reference

Every `nmt-forge` subcommand, generated directly from the CLI parser so this
page cannot drift from the tool. For the *why* behind each guard, see
[Train a Model Honestly](/docs/network/getting-started/training-honestly); for
driving forge from an agent, see
[Train Your First Model (with your agent)](/docs/network/getting-started/train-your-first-model).

**The global flag:** `--workspace <dir>` (default `./.forge`) precedes every
subcommand and names the project you are operating on.

Agents: call `nmt-forge status --json` first — it tells you which of these to
run next.


## `discover`

what does this language have? (reads the SSOT language card; absence = unknown, never zero)

**Arguments:**

- `code` — ISO 639-3 code (e.g. crk, fra, nav, arb)

**Options:**

- `--cards-dir` — language-cards directory (default: $CHAMPOLLION_CARDS_DIR or monorepo walk-up)
- `--json` — 
- `--no-registry` — skip the mt-eval registry cross-check of eval datasets

## `init`

scaffold a project from a language card: workspace + starter config + NEXT_STEPS.md

**Arguments:**

- `code` — ISO 639-3 code of the TARGET language

**Options:**

- `--dir` — project directory (default .)
- `--pair` — language pair as SRC-TGT (default eng-<code>)
- `--cards-dir` — 

## `status`

where am I? state table + THE next command (agents: call this first, use --json)

**Options:**

- `--json` —

- `--json` —

## `score`

score hypotheses on a registered set (CIs always)

**Options:**

- `--eval-set` — 
- `--config` — run-config path: drives the battery from its eval block (registered battery, grouping, plugins, canonicalizer, prereg binding) — one file, whole eval
- `--hyps` *(required)* — 
- `--config-hash` — 
- `--metric` — lane to score (repeatable): chrf++, bleu, exact_match, comet, comet-qe, metricx (default: chrf++/bleu/exact_match)
- `--target-lang` — ISO 639-3 target code — resolves the right neural metric model and its low-resource warning
- `--plugin` — LYSS-protocol metric plugin, 'module.path:ClassName' (repeatable); its numeric aggregates become CI'd lanes
- `--card-plugins` — run the harness's plugin discovery for this language (card evalMetrics + FST validity + behavioral linters)
- `--override-respend` — 
- `--json-out` —

## `evaluate`

close the loop: decode the config's battery with the run's SELECTED checkpoint, score it (CIs, prereg-gated) and auto-diagnose — no manual decode

**Arguments:**

- `run_manifest` — run-manifest.json written by `nmt-forge run`

**Options:**

- `--config` — run-config path (defaults to the config embedded in the run manifest); must carry an eval block
- `--out-hyps` — where to write decoded battery hypotheses (default: alongside the run manifest)
